name: Abertay University

facts.text: Abertay University is on Bell Street in Dundee, Scotland, DD1 1HG. It is a separate institution from the University of Dundee.
facts.sourceTitle: Abertay: How to Apply as an International Student

facts.text: The Dundee city-centre campus has the Bernard King Library, study and social spaces, and specialist teaching and research labs; applicants should check facilities for their own programme.
Abertay uses CAS Shield; a recorded Pre-CAS credibility interview may be requested about the applicant’s decision to study there. It is not stated to be compulsory for every applicant.
facts.sourceTitle: Abertay: How to Apply as an International Student

facts.text: Credibility assessment includes submitted documents, personal information, funding evidence and the questionnaire. Abertay may request further information before issuing a CAS.
facts.sourceTitle: Abertay: CAS Shield Credibility Assessment Information

facts.text: The applicant must complete the Pre-CAS questionnaire honestly and independently; an agent must not complete it for them.
facts.sourceTitle: Abertay: How to Complete Your CAS Shield Profile

facts.text: Interview invitations go to the student, not the agent. The checklist says instructions specify preparation and answer times, with one answer per question and no resits; follow the actual invitation for current arrangements.
facts.sourceTitle: Abertay: CAS Shield Credibility Assessment Information

facts.text: CAS Shield funding details include scholarship amounts, balances and sources. Use the current offer and receipts for fees/deposit; do not use historic webinar figures. Official loan/sponsorship evidence routes may differ from bank-fund evidence.
facts.sourceTitle: Abertay: How to Complete Your CAS Shield Profile

facts.text: Parker House is managed by iQ on Parker Street, around five minutes’ walk from campus. Limited reduced-rate rooms for Abertay students are first come, first served; standard-rate and other Dundee options may be available.
facts.sourceTitle: Abertay: Rooms and Halls of Residence

facts.text: Parker House rooms include bills and wifi; laundry is pay-as-you-go. Confirm the current provider quote, availability, contract length and inclusions rather than assuming a fixed rent.
facts.sourceTitle: Abertay: Rooms and Halls of Residence

facts.text: Only for MSc Ethical Hacking and Cybersecurity: the on-campus full-time route is 12 months and the 24-month distance route is for UK applicants. Its NCSC certification and curriculum must not be attributed to every Abertay degree.
facts.sourceTitle: Abertay: MSc Ethical Hacking and Cybersecurity
